purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for federated sources, query plans, pushdown, source governance, consistency evidence and partial-result/failure state.

topics.name: DWH Federation Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for federated sources, query plans, pushdown, source governance, consistency evidence and partial-result/failure state.

semantics.identity_rule: Source origin, endpoint, plan, query execution, source fragment and result identities remain distinct.
semantics.ownership_rule: UI shows per-origin owners/governance instead of attributing data ownership to federation.
semantics.action_rule: query/resync/retry/change-consistency/rebind-source operations invoke separate authorized canonical workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing federated topology grants no source data authority.
semantics.graph_rule: Visual source/plan edges correspond only to explicit refs.
semantics.failure_rule: Partial, stale, denied and inconsistent states are visibly distinct.

invariants.rule: Federated DWH access preserves each origin's exact identity, schema, governance, lineage and consistency evidence; combining results never centralizes semantic ownership or silently expands authorization.

hard_gates.condition: monitor conflates endpoint and source identity
federated node displayed as owner of remote data
